nom: TATCHA The Silk Peony Line-Smoothing Eye Cream

avis.texte: This one was disappointing because of the price point; but the product didn't do anything for me; I am still actively using it because I don't want to waste this product (again, the PRICE dude)...but it's very over-hyped, and the plastic packaging for this and all the Tatcha products feel very cheap for what you're paying. Not impressed.

avis.titre: Keeps undereye make up in place like a saint
avis.texte: This eye cream keeps under eye concealer from creasing easily, keeps it in place like I've never seen in 40+ years. Does smooth fine lines doesn't erase. Also lightens the undereye slightly because of its white shade.
Bought this for my mother in law, saw improvement less than a week

avis.titre: Gave me bumps, previous formula was better
avis.texte: I loved this product from tatcha before they changed the formula and added whey protein which seems to cause bumps under my eyes so i can no longer use it and need a new under eye cream
I love this product sooo much but im worried im allergic to something in it. It feels amazing on my sensitve skin and absorbs nicely into the skin. I just eish it didnt make me itchy!!
This eye cream is amazing, already got me a second jar, my crows feet are less visible and my under eye puffiness is getting better as well, smooth and very soothing. I love this one

Just started using this product a little over a week ago, not seeing much reduction in puffiness or fine lines yet, however the skin under and around my eyes feels amazing, hoping to see more improvement the longer I use it.

I love this brand and use most all of their products. I thought this eye cream woyos be heavenly, but its not. I do thinkbits mousturizing, but I'm not seeing any kind of firmimg qualities. I feel like this is more novelty than anything. Cute packaging, but not grown up eye cream for me at 50.
I love this eye cream, I put it under my eyes and over my eyelids every night.
I have tried many eye creams and Tatcha is the best. The texture is creamy and it absorbs quickly. It never interferes with concealer. I will always be a Tatcha customer.

avis.titre: Tatcha Silk Peony Line-Smoothing Eye Cream
avis.texte: I have used many different brands of skincare products for around my eyes and have spent anywhere from $200+ to as low as $15. Tatcha Silk Peony is the tops, and at age 64 I am very impressed with this entire line of skincare!

This eye cream is a big no for me. It did not hydrate and, in fact, the area around my eyes looked worse. Super drying and my eyes aged about 10 years. Kinda pricey to learn that lesson but maybe others wont have such an adverse reaction?

I have really tried to like this brand. Another fail. I dont get it. This eye lotion does absolutely nothing. Goal was to moisturiamze aging skin and hide dark circles. It dows neither. My skin actually looks worse after use.

I have tried every eye cream possible and nothing truly helped the combination of converns i had, such as texture and discoloration, but yet i tend to get oily eyelids, so heavy anti aging creams were a nightmare and would run into my eyes and burn or cause my eye makeup to run…this gold is like smooth delicate clouds that effortlessly absorb into the skin. My under eye makeup has never looked better and my mid 40's eye area is no longer an issue. I've only been using it for 3 weeks and noticed a difference after 2 days and it just keeps getting better and better. I honestly woukd pay $100+ for this eye cream because it is that incredible. Honest product junky review….and i NEVER post reviews.
This is the first time I have used Tatcha skincare products and I love how creamy and moisturizing this eye cream feels

I am sorry to say that I can't reorder this or any product that contains tocopheryl acetate for which I'm allergic Fortunately Tatcha has many wonderful products without this synthetic ingredient which I can enjoy
